question: Micanite paper consists of soft mica bonded with which material?
solution:
The correct answer is __Paper or cloth base__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Micanite paper__ consists of soft mica bonded with a paper or cloth base.
 
• Micanite paper is commonly used as an insulating material in electrical applications.
 
• It is flexible and can be shaped into various forms, making it suitable for different industrial purposes.
 
• The bonding of mica with a paper or cloth base enhances its durability and usability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Glass Fibre:**
 
 
• It is used in applications requiring high tensile strength and durability, such as in composites and insulation.
 
• However, it is not a component of micanite paper.
 
 
 
• **Cotton and Silk:**
 
 
• Cotton and silk are natural fibers used in textiles but are not typically used in micanite paper.
 
 
 
• **Rubber:**
 
 
• Rubber is commonly used for insulation and sealing but does not play a role in the composition of micanite paper.
